# staticform_collaborator (Resource)

A collaborator on a form, managed by email. Creating the resource sends an invitation; the invitee must accept it out of band. Permission changes apply once the invitation is accepted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "staticform_collaborator" "editor" {
  form_id              = staticform_form.contact.id
  email                = "colleague@example.com"
  can_view_form        = true
  can_edit_form        = true
  can_view_submissions = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Collaborator's email address.
- `form_id` (String) Form to add the collaborator to.

### Optional

- `can_edit_form` (Boolean)
- `can_edit_submissions` (Boolean)
- `can_manage_collaborators` (Boolean)
- `can_view_form` (Boolean)
- `can_view_submissions` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier (`form_id:email`).
- `status` (String) `Pending` (invitation sent) or `Accepted`.
- `user_id` (String) User ID, once the invitation is accepted.
